[[Acolyte Jorg]] is a Redemptor guarding the gate into the [[Unwaking Waters (Kurzick)]] mission location.

==Location==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|Morostav Trail}} (near gate to [[Unwaking Waters (Kurzick)]])

==Quests==
'''Quests involved in:'''
*Echovald Forest
**[[Into the Whirlpool]]

==Dialogue==
Prior to completing [[The Eternal Grove]] mission:
:''"I cannot allow those who are not part of the Kurzick Empire to pass into this area. For all I know, you may be spies. Come to think of it, why aren't you at the Eternal Grove defending the [[Forever Tree]]s? Hmm? If you really want to prove your loyalty to the Kurzicks, <[[character]] name> should journey there. I've nothing else to say to you until then.''

:''Why are you still here?"''

Prior to accepting the [[Into the Whirlpool]] quest:
:''"<Character name> might want to journey to [[Vasburg Armory]] to speak with [[Baron Mirek Vasburg]]. He is in charge of this area.''

:''Is there anything else you wish to discuss?"''

During the above quest, while not accompanied by Brother [[Mhenlo]]:
:''"The count send you with Mhenlo, you say? Why should I believe you? For all I know, he might be dead. <Character name> should bring him here. Maybe then I'll be convinced you aren't spies.''

:''Well, what is it? What else do you wish to discuss?"''

During the above quest, while accompanied by Brother Mhenlo:
:''"This gate leads to the Unwaking Waters. Not many know of this entrance, and we'd prefer it stay that way, so keep it to yourself.''

:''What else can I help you with?"''

After completion of the aforementioned quest:
:''"Please continue on through."''
